new_entities.name: VrpConsent
new_entities.description: A Variable Recurring Payment consent granted by a customer to a PISP/merchant. Defines the parameters within which the PISP may initiate payments without per-payment SCA. Owned by SVC-009 (Domestic Payments) as the payment-capable service. Lifecycle: pending_authorisation → active → revoked | expired.

fields.name: consent_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this VRP consent

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: FK to customer; consent owner

fields.name: tpp_client_id
fields.description: TPP's OAuth client_id from Dynamic Client Registration

fields.name: tpp_name
fields.description: Display name of the TPP/merchant for customer-facing UI

fields.name: source_account_id
fields.description: Customer's account from which payments will be debited

fields.name: payee_name
fields.description: Beneficiary name for VRP payments

fields.name: payee_sort_code
fields.description: Beneficiary sort code

fields.name: payee_account_number
fields.description: Beneficiary account number

fields.name: max_single_payment_amount
fields.description: Maximum amount permitted per individual VRP payment (GBP)

fields.name: max_monthly_aggregate_amount
fields.description: Maximum aggregate payments permitted per calendar month (GBP)

fields.name: payment_category
fields.description: FCA cVRP category: subscription | bill_payment | top_up | other

fields.name: valid_from
fields.description: Date from which consent is effective

fields.name: valid_to
fields.description: Consent expiry date — maximum 12 months from grant

fields.name: status
fields.description: Lifecycle state: pending_authorisation | active | revoked | expired

fields.name: sca_assertion_ref
fields.description: SCA assertion reference proving customer authorised the consent

fields.name: current_month_aggregate
fields.description: Running total of payments made in the current calendar month under this consent

fields.name: granted_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when customer granted consent

fields.name: revoked_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when consent was revoked (null if active/expired)

fields.name: revocation_reason
fields.description: customer_initiated | tpp_initiated | bank_suspended | expired

design_decisions: ENT-070 owned by SVC-009 (Domestic Payments, CAP-003), not SVC-017 (Digital Channels). Consent is a payment domain entity.
current_month_aggregate is a computed field maintained by SVC-009 on every VrpPayment execution; not a derived view.

new_entities.name: VrpPayment
new_entities.description: A single VRP payment instruction executed under an active VrpConsent. Each VrpPayment is a Faster Payment debiting the customer's source account and crediting the PISP's nominated payee. Owned by SVC-009.

fields.name: vrp_payment_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this VRP payment

fields.name: consent_id
fields.description: FK to VrpConsent authorising this payment

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: FK to customer

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Payment amount in GBP

fields.name: reference
fields.description: Payment reference supplied by PISP

fields.name: fps_end_to_end_id
fields.description: Faster Payments end-to-end ID for settlement tracking

fields.name: fraud_score
fields.description: Fraud score from SVC-013 at time of payment (internal only)

fields.name: status
fields.description: pending | executed | rejected | fraud_held

fields.name: reject_reason
fields.description: Rejection reason if status = rejected: consent_parameter_breach | insufficient_funds | consent_expired | consent_revoked

fields.name: initiated_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when payment instruction received

fields.name: executed_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when FPS payment confirmed

design_decisions: VrpPayment is a separate entity from VrpConsent to enable per-payment audit and parameter enforcement without mutating the consent record.

referenced_existing_entities.name: CurrentAccount
referenced_existing_entities.purpose: Source account for VRP debits; balance check performed by SVC-009 before payment execution
